thought.text: Both servers are up — Rails on port 3000, Vite on 3036. Now let me verify the app responds at http://localhost:3000.

reasoning_content:
The Rails app is up and running, with Puma listening on port 3000, and Vite is running on port 3036. Let's verify:
1. curl http://localhost:3000 — should return the sign-in page
2. Check the admin user in the DB
3. If necessary, test logging in via the API

Let's do the HTTP verification.

action.command:
echo "=== curl localhost:3000 ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/page.html -w "HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000
echo "--- page body (first 40 lines) ---"
head -40 /tmp/page.html
echo "=== sign-in page ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/signin.html -w "HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/users/sign-in
grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/signin.html 2>/dev/null || head -5 /tmp/signin.html
